description:
After many years and miles are driven, the headlights on the average car or truck have been dimmed by abrasion from road debris, and yellowed and discolored from the sun and elements. A dim, cloudy, yellowed, or non-functioning headlight makes driving dangerous. Don’t risk your safety because of high dealer prices, you can get this Factory style headlight from YITAMOTO for much less. It’s the same as original equipment in fit, performance, and function.
Fitment
2005-2007 Ford F-250 Super Duty models only
2005-2007 Ford F-350 Super Duty models only
2005-2007 Ford F-450 Super Duty models only
2005-2007 Ford F-550 Super Duty models only
2005 Ford Excursion US models only
Do not fit with the Sealed Beam Headlight model
Professional installation would be highly recommended
Features
Fitment: Compatible with 2005 2006 2007 Ford F250 F350 F450 F550 Super Duty, 2005 Ford Excursion (US Models Only, Not fit with Sealed Beam Headlight Model)
Weather-Sealed & Solid Housing: Fully sealed structure improves waterproof performance, so rainy days are no longer a concern. The upgraded housing is also shock-proof and heat-repellent, ensuring lasting durability in any condition
Bulbs Requirement: High beam bulb type: H13; Low beam bulb type: H13. Kindly be noted that halogen bulbs are NOT included
Enhanced Brightness: Designed with a robust polycarbonate reflector and complementary lighting, these boost brightness for improved visibility in low-light conditions. They ensure a safer, clearer driving experience
Plug-n-Play Installation: This DOT-certified bolt-on style headlights are designed for quick and easy installation, no modification or drilling needed. Professional installation would be highly recommended
